rules:
🍻 SLOSHED RULES
Pull up a stool. Respect the bar.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
① | 18+ ONLY - this server is strictly for members 18+.
② | NO HATE - No racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, discrimination, or hate speech.
③ | NO HARASSMENT - Keep it friendly. No bullying, stalking, intimidation, or targeted harassment.
④ | RESPECT OTHERS - Respect different beliefs, cultures, opinions, and personal boundaries.
⑤ | THIS AIN'T TINDER - Don't treat the server like a dating app. Respect "no."
⑥ | RESPECT STAFF - Follow Moderator/Admin instructions. Use ModMail for concerns.
⑦ | LURKERS WELCOME - You don't have to chat—just follow the rules.
⑧ | USE THE RIGHT CHANNELS - Keep discussions in their appropriate channels.
⑨ | NO DOXXING OR THREATS - No sharing personal information, threats, hacking, or malicious activity.
⑩ | NO DRAMA - Keep personal disputes out of the server.
⑪ | ASK IF UNSURE - If you're unsure about something, ask a staff member first.
⑫ | STAFF ACCOUNTABILITY - Staff are held to a higher standard and are accountable for their actions.
⑬ | DON'T RUIN THE VIBE - If you're consistently toxic or disruptive, expect consequences.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🍺 Golden Rule - Don't be an asshole. Use common sense, respect everyone, and enjoy your stay.

If you remember it... it probably didn't count
So grab a seat, pour another round, and enjoy the night.
